sql: SELECT r.narrative, r.amount, r.measures FROM readings r JOIN subjects s ON s.person=r.person WHERE s.title='Mr.' AND s.given='Vincent' AND s.surname='Wyman' AND r.narrative='Body Height' AND r.day='2010-08-02'
SELECT DISTINCT rr.commonness_share FROM diagnoses d JOIN rate_rollup rr ON lower(rr.element)=lower(d.narrative) WHERE d.token=64859006

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.person) FROM drugs d JOIN subjects s ON s.person=d.person WHERE d.narrative='Ibuprofen 200 MG Oral Tablet' AND d.onset LIKE '2016%' AND s.culture='dominican' AND strftime('%m',d.finish)-strftime('%m',d.onset)=1
SELECT DISTINCT d.person FROM diagnoses d JOIN rate_rollup rr ON lower(rr.element)=lower(d.narrative) WHERE rr.commonness_share=18.8
SELECT DISTINCT s.given, s.surname FROM drugs d JOIN subjects s ON s.person=d.person WHERE d.narrative='Clopidogrel 75 MG Oral Tablet' AND strftime('%Y',d.finish)-strftime('%Y',d.onset)>10
SELECT DISTINCT rr.commonness_proportion FROM diagnoses d JOIN rate_rollup rr ON lower(rr.element)=lower(d.narrative) WHERE d.onset='2014-05-09'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN i.narrative='Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(i.person), SUM(CASE WHEN i.narrative='Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' AND s.culture='english' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM shots i JOIN subjects s ON s.person=i.person WHERE strftime('%Y',i.day)='2017'
